attributes.action: Do Not Disconnect UK Copper Landlines in Jan 27! Protect National Resilience!
attributes.additional_details: Copper landlines work in a POWER CUT. Removing them makes the UK MUCH MORE VULNERABLE to disruption caused by internet failure, AI hacking or attack on deep sea cables by hostile states. It is essential in this time of global uncertainty to maintain landlines & PROTECT SUPPLY CHAINS, KEEP FAMILIES IN TOUCH, CONNECT remote rural communities, elderly & disabled people needing medical assistance such as emergency personal alarms. When all digital communications go down LANDLINES HELP KEEP US SAFE!
attributes.background:
Landlines are a critical layer of UK resilience DO NOT REMOVE THEM! Or Britain will be left dangerously exposed in national emergencies.
During blackouts, cyberattacks or hostile attacks on deep sea cables, millions will lose digital communications. Landlines can PROTECT SUPPLY CHAINS & COMMUNITIES

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: 
Halt copper landline switch-off in all areas
